grades.quote: The conversions follow the same rules on exceptional conditions as the scalar conversion instructions.
grades.reason: This passage covers vector float-to-integer conversions, not scalar FCVT.W.S. It only says they follow the scalar conversion rules on exceptional conditions. It never gives the saturated result or the flags for an out-of-range input.
This is an encoding table for RV32F instructions. It lists FCVT.WU.S and FCVT.S.W but says nothing about FCVT.W.S results or flags for out-of-range inputs.
This passage lists a reserved encoding for the BF16 vector narrowing convert. It is unrelated to scalar FCVT.W.S out-of-range behavior.

grades.quote: Floating-point exception flags are raised the same as they would be for FCVT.W.D with the same input operand.
grades.reason: This passage covers the Zfa FCVTMOD.W.D instruction, not FCVT.W.S. It only says its exception flags match those of FCVT.W.D, and that NaN converts to zero. It gives no actual saturated result or flag behavior for FCVT.W.S.
